pages.title: Brush and Ink
pages.text: Shapelessly combine a Brush with Cinnabar Blood Ink. The resulting Brush and Ink has 20 durability and is the dedicated tool for the Scholar Table's Talisman Making page.

pages.title: Talisman Making
pages.text: Right-click a Scholar Table and switch to Talisman Making. Put Brush and Ink in the lower-left tool slot, then arrange ingredients in the seven ring slots. The center previews an output only when every position matches a recipe.

pages.title: Materials and Durability
pages.text: Taking the center output consumes one item from every occupied recipe slot. Making $(item)Talisman Paper$() does not damage Brush and Ink; every completed talisman costs 1 durability.$(br2)JEI and EMI display all seven-slot layouts and their exact order.

pages.title: Two Talisman Interfaces
pages.text: This entry describes only the Scholar Table page. The older Talisman Master skill still opens a separate interface that accepts a Brush and Cinnabar Blood Ink individually and follows its own tool rules.
